the study of hadron spectra and collective flow from the initial stages of heavy ion collisions at RHIC energies to the hadronization of the quark gluon plasma and subsequent hadronization and rescattering in the hadronic phase.

the study of the space-time evolution and hadronization of hot and dense nuclear matter in the framework of relativistic hydrodynamics.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the measured elliptic flow data are consistent with a picture in which the QGP is a weakly interacting, near-perfect fluid, while the measured pion spectra are consistent with the assumption that there is a significant contribution from hadronization at freeze-out to the pion spectra.

the hybrid approach is able to simultaneously describe the bulk hadron p{sub T}, the bulk elliptic flow, and the hadron elliptic and triangular flow, without the need to tune any parameters to the experimental data.
